Anna — thanks for the clear note, welcome!

Quick answers up front: 
- Redwood's standard onboarding default is Net 30. In practice we can evaluate Net 45 for strategic partners, but that requires procurement approval and an initial credit evaluation (typical timeline 1–2 weeks).
- We do offer an early-pay program (pilot) managed by Finance. Typical structure is a small percentage discount (1.0–2.0%) in exchange for accelerated payment (Net15 or Net10). Enrollment requires agreeing to an early-pay term sheet and tagging invoices with an enrollment code so Finance can pick them up in the automated payment run.
- PO routing: once vendor is active we issue POs from procurement with the format RDW-PO-YYYY-XXXXX. Invoices should be sent to ap@redwood.com and include the PO number, invoice date, and a line-item mapping to the Redwood product code (we'll supply sample).

I've looped in Priyom (procurement) and Kimberly (finance) to share the onboarding checklist and the early-pay enrollment details. Priyom — can you take point on vendor record creation and send the onboarding form? Kimberly — can you share the early-pay enrollment doc and confirm the discount band we can offer for Payline?

If you'd like a quick 30-min sync tomorrow (Tue) to walk through form fields, I'm available 11:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:00 PT.

Best,
Grace O'Connor

Hi all —

Thanks Grace. Anna, great to meet you. Below is the onboarding checklist and a short summary of the PO/AR flow so you can prepare the right artifacts. I've attached the vendor form and our standard MSA addendum for early-pay pilots.

Onboarding checklist (required to create vendor record):
- Completed Redwood Vendor Onboarding Form (attached: Payline_Onboarding_Form.pdf)
- Valid W9 or W8BEN (attached: W9_Payline.pdf)
- Certificate of Insurance (COI) if applicable for services (> $50k)
- Bank details via our secure vendor portal (we cannot accept bank details over unencrypted email)
- Contact and remit-to email for invoicing

PO and invoice routing rules:
- Procurement will create an internal vendor_id and issue POs to the vendor email on file.
- PO format: RDW-PO-2027-#####. Please include the PO number on the invoice header and at least one line mapping to the product code Red-INF-XX.
- Invoices should be emailed to ap@redwood.com (PDF preferred) and CC procurement@redwood.com for the first invoice so we can verify mapping.

Early-pay pilot note:
- Attached is the draft MutualActionPlan and an early-pay enrollment sheet (Signed_MutualActionPlan.docx). Enrollment requires Vendor signature and a short enrollment form.
- Finance typically offers 0.75%–1.75% discount depending on volume and payment cadence; we need Kimberly to confirm the range available for Payline.
- Operational requirement: enrollments must tag invoices with EARLYPAY-<vendor_id> so the AP system picks them up in the early-pay run.

Next steps / timeline: 
1) Anna: return the completed onboarding form + W9 + signed MAP via the DocuSign link (or upload to portal).
2) Procurement: create vendor record and provide vendor_id + sample PO within 48 business hours of receiving completed docs.
3) Finance: confirm early-pay discount band and send enrollment form.

Attachments: Payline_Onboarding_Form.pdf (fillable), W9_Payline.pdf, Signed_MutualActionPlan.docx (stub)
